workouts.title: Welcome to the new cycle!
workouts.description:
Welcome to the weightlifting phase! 
This week will be a test week, we will test the snatch on Monday and the Clean & Jerk on Friday. So, like last week, take everything else at a general RPE 7 as a limit. We will have a lot of chances for high intensity throughout this 8 week training phase.

Have fun, good luck! Wishing you more PR’s!
